findings.summary: The labelled 'gc.auto 6,700' reference line and the top of the 6,737 loose-object bar render on the same pixel rows (207-208), so the bar's edge and the threshold are one indistinguishable line: a reader cannot see that the loose count stood above the automatic-gc threshold, only the two printed numbers saying so. The 37-object gap is 0.5% of an 8,000-unit axis, sub-pixel at this figure height. It matters because the threshold is the reason the count mattered, and the annotation asserts a relationship the plot cannot show.

The right-hand 'packs' panel draws two exact integers (4 before, 2 after) as bars, carrying no visual magnitude a table row does not, and the evidence fragment immediately beneath the figure already tabulates both values. The loose-objects panel earns its bars; the packs panel spends roughly a third of the figure's width restating a table row.

raw_text:
RUBRIC legibility: passes — bars labelled with exact counts beneath a shared legend; readable at a glance.
RUBRIC data_ink: passes — solid grey and green bars carry the weight; no fills or shadows.
RUBRIC decoration: passes — no gradient, background fill or decorative styling; one dotted threshold line is data.
RUBRIC contrast: passes — #333 and #6f6f6f text on white; green labels 4.24:1, above the large-text floor.
RUBRIC table_form: defect — the packs panel (4 to 2) restates a table row already tabulated beside the figure.
RUBRIC label_collision: passes — nothing clipped at the canvas edges, no overlapping labels, labels clear of the bars.

rubric_verdicts.contrast: passes — panel titles and tick text are #333 on white (about 12.6:1), the value labels #6f6f6f (about 5.0:1); the green value labels (#2e8b57) measure 4.24:1, above the 3:1 large-text contrast floor and legible, though just under the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold.
rubric_verdicts.data_ink: passes — solid #929292 and #2e8b57 bars carry the weight, with no fills, borders, shadows or background tint; the only ink beyond the bars is the axes, tick labels, the legend and one labelled threshold line, each of which carries meaning.
rubric_verdicts.decoration: passes — no gradient, background fill, frame or drop shadow; the single dotted grey line at 6,700 is a labelled data threshold (gc.auto), not styling.
rubric_verdicts.label_collision: passes — no pixel touches any canvas border (zero non-background pixels on all four edges), no two labels overlap, and each value label sits clear above its bar.
rubric_verdicts.legibility: passes — two titled panels on white, each bar labelled with its exact count (loose objects 6,737 before / 0 after; packs 4 / 2) beneath one shared two-entry legend; the before/after collapse reads at a glance.
rubric_verdicts.table_form: defect (non-blocking) — the loose-objects panel earns its bars (6,737 to 0 is a visual collapse), but the right-hand packs panel draws 4 to 2, two exact integers that carry no visual magnitude a table row does not, and the evidence fragment immediately beneath the figure already tabulates both; a third of the figure's width restates a table row.
